How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Project Consultant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 18-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Roorkee Project Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email for the Project Consultant post at IIT Roorkee is 18 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Consultant at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Project Consultant post in the IIT Roorkee recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Roorkee Project Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Project Consultant position at IIT Roorkee is via Email. Candidates need to send their applications to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Consultant post at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The Project Consultant selected at IIT Roorkee will receive a salary of Rs. 1,50,000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Project Consultant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PhD in Earth Sciences with at least 20 years of relevant experience to be eligible for the Project Consultant post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Roorkee Project Consultant Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Project Consultant post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Consultant post at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Consultant position at IIT Roorkee involves an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview date for the Project Consultant position?
faq.answer: The interview for the Project Consultant post at IIT Roorkee is scheduled for 24 September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Project Consultant be posted?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Consultant post is Roorkee, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is the Project Consultant position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The Project Consultant position at IIT Roorkee is a Contract-based government job.
